title: Studio Membership (Mainstay and Enthusiast)
summary: Monthly studio membership at Bellevue or Redmond locations (at capacity with waitlist) includes 24/7 studio access and use of electric and raku kilns with 10-day turnaround.
how_to_join: Prior ceramics experience required; join waitlist at either location
source_quote: Electric and raku kilns for low and mid-range firings with a 10-day turnaround
evidence_sentence: The memberships page states that all memberships include access to electric and raku kilns for low and mid-range firings.
evidence_quote: Electric and raku kilns for low and mid-range firings with a 10-day turnaround
